decisions.reason: As an upgraded and renamed version of an already accepted trommel screen, it appears to be a low-cost continuation of a proven option in a core screening category, so we would keep it.
The 2019 Stage V update across the AK series signals renewed commitment in a core mobile shredding line, so despite some remaining market uncertainty the option is worth keeping open.
Its move from a simple mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 suggests the product cleared an initial test and fits the firm’s mobile processing focus, so we would keep it.
The CERON line shows the strongest evidence of commitment and market validation, including claims of segment leadership and named application use, so it should remain in the portfolio.
